hooks.command: payload=$(jq -r '[.tool_input?, .tool_input.command?, .tool_input.file_path?, .tool_input.patch?, .tool_input.input?] | map(select(type == "string")) | join("\n")'); case "$payload" in *plugins/core/*|*prompts/*|*snippets/*) printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Agent Kit contributor reminder: if installed behavior changed, bump the asset version and both Core manifests in lockstep, run the repository checks, then tell the owner which runtime cache may need an explicit update.
